headline: One Night From Real Football
dek: The EFL reaches the final hours of preseason with no completed fantasy results yet, a stable contender tier at the top and the first real Week 1 evidence arriving when the NFL season opens September 9.

lead.title: The Preview Era Ends Here — Tomorrow the EFL Starts Producing Receipts
lead.body: There is still no completed 2026 EFL fantasy week to recap as of September 8, so this edition remains a factual Week 1 preview rather than a manufactured results column. The NFL regular season opens Wednesday, September 9, which means the next EFL report can finally judge actual scoring, winners, losers and lineup decisions. The latest published EFL power board, generated September 1 from Sleeper-based roster and matchup inputs, still has Master Peyton first at 88.7, The Don’s Soldiers second at 84.1, Kaaron Rodgers third at 83.8 and defending champion Blaze Infantry fourth at 75.5. Beneath that top tier, The Duke moved up to sixth, Mach Chicken slipped to seventh, 28Wizardking and LandsharkSC each gained a spot, and bonebuster fell two places to eleventh. For now those are preseason signals only. Beginning tomorrow, the league gets real evidence.

briefs.label: POWER BOARD
briefs.title: Master Peyton Carries No. 1 Into Opening Night
briefs.body: The September 1 EFL ranking model keeps Master Peyton on top with an 88.7 Power Score and A+ grades for lineup, depth, health and recent form. The Don’s Soldiers sits second at 84.1 and Kaaron Rodgers third at 83.8, leaving only 0.3 points between the two closest members of the top three.

briefs.label: RISERS & FALLERS
briefs.title: The Middle of the Table Already Has Movement
briefs.body: The Duke climbed one position to No. 6, while Mach Chicken dropped one to No. 7. Farther down, 28Wizardking rose to ninth and LandsharkSC to tenth, while bonebuster took the sharpest preseason slide, falling two positions to No. 11. Those moves are model movement, not on-field verdicts.

briefs.label: MATCHUP BOARD
briefs.title: The Top Four All Draw Different Opening Tests
briefs.body: Week 1 pairs No. 1 Master Peyton with The Duke, No. 2 The Don’s Soldiers with LandsharkSC, No. 3 Kaaron Rodgers with KamaraVirus125177, and No. 4 Blaze Infantry with No. 5 Trash Pandas. The Blaze–Trash Pandas matchup is the only opening pairing featuring two teams currently ranked inside the EFL top five.

briefs.label: NEWSROOM NOTE
briefs.title: No Box Scores Means No Fake Trends
briefs.body: Because Week 1 has not begun, there are no completed fantasy scores, scoring trends or matchup outcomes to analyze yet. This edition also avoids assigning impact to trades, waivers or free-agent moves without a completed week to evaluate them against. The next report can shift fully into results mode once Sleeper has a finished Week 1 ledger.
